meta.name: Angel Engine Mobile
meta.description: Intentional deviations of the mobile companion from the desktop design-system contract. Shared semantic colors, type families, radius, status, and chart meaning match desktop grass/DM Sans; this file records only platform-specific density and chrome differences.

density.touch_target: 2.75rem (44px) minimum hit target via --touch-target; desktop pointer chrome is denser
density.workspace_mode_ladder: Not used on mobile; no [data-workspace-mode] type compression
density.safe_area: Uses env(safe-area-inset-*) on shell, drawers, FAB, and footers

chrome.macos_sidebar: No --macos-sidebar-background; mobile uses standard sidebar tokens only
chrome.workspace_composer_tokens: Desktop-only composer sizing tokens are omitted

shared_meaning.primary: Same grass #59802c light / #8dbb56 dark as desktop
shared_meaning.background: Same paper #f5f8ee light / #0c0d0b dark as desktop
shared_meaning.azure: Retained only for status-info and non-accent chart roles, not product primary
